name: A straight path
hint: The R rune moves the ember right. Click on it to add it to your spell. You'll need to use it multiple times to make the ember reach the lock's heart.
small_hint: Add runes to create a spell that moves the yellow ember to the purple heart of the lock.

name: The first twist
hint: Use ᚢ, ᛞ, ᛈ and ᚱ to navigate the ember to the lock's heart. You can drag runes to re-order them.

name: A third test
hint: You're getting the hang of this now

name: Seems familiar
hint: This lock has a limit on how much fireweight you can use. Each movement rune uses 3 shingles. You'll need to use the ᚴ rune to increase the value in the multiplier. Each movement rune moves the ember by this amount, so if you make the value bigger the rune will move you more spaces for the same amount of fireweight. If it gets confusing try step mode to run the spell one rune at a time.
small_hint: You have less fireweight this time. You can increase the number of squares moved per rune with ᚴ

name: Wrong Turn
hint: Use ᚴ and ᚾ to keep within the rune limit.

name: Follow the fire
hint: You don't have much fireweight, but each fire you cross gives you 6 shingles more. Follow the fires to reach the heart without running out.
small_hint: Each time you cross a fire you gain 6 shingles of fireweight

name: Don't get stuck
hint: The - squares decrease the multiplier. Use the ᚴ rune to keep it above 0.
small_hint: The - squares decrease the multiplier. If it reaches 0, the runes won't move the ember at all

name: A tough lock
hint: The + squares increase the multiplier which might make you move too far. Use the ᚾ rune to decrease it and navigate tight spaces.
small_hint: The + squares increase the multiplier, which might make navigating tight spaces hard

name: Long Jump
hint: You don't have enough fireweight to reach the heart, but you can build up a store by going back and forth over replenish squares that are close together
small_hint: You can build up fireweight by going back and forth over squares where it's close together

name: Launchpad
hint: You can accumulate fireweight by going back and forth over recharge squares when they are close together.

name: The Crooked Path
hint: Long straight corridors reward careful use of ᚴ and ᚾ

name: Titus' Snare
hint: You'll need ever trick you've learnt to get past Titus' final lock
